finding: _sanitizeHref() uses new URL(href, window.location.href) without SSR guard. Called during render() — window.location is undefined during SSR and will throw ReferenceError.
suggestion: Add guard: if (typeof window === 'undefined') return href; at top of _sanitizeHref()

finding: connectedCallback calls document.addEventListener('click', ...) without SSR guard. While Lit SSR typically skips connectedCallback, custom SSR environments may invoke it.
suggestion: Wrap in if (typeof document !== 'undefined') guard

finding: _getAnimationDuration() calls window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') without SSR guard. Inconsistent with hx-carousel, hx-counter, hx-toast, hx-theme which all guard this same API.
suggestion: Add if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 0; at start of _getAnimationDuration()

finding: connectedCallback calls requestAnimationFrame() without SSR guard when positionInPixels is set. During SSR, requestAnimationFrame is undefined.
suggestion: Wrap in if (typeof requestAnimationFrame !== 'undefined') or if (typeof window !== 'undefined') guard

finding: connectedCallback creates new MutationObserver() without SSR guard. MutationObserver is a browser-only API unavailable in Node.js SSR environments.
suggestion: Wrap MutationObserver instantiation in if (typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined') guard

finding: connectedCallback creates new MutationObserver() without SSR guard. Same pattern as hx-accordion.
suggestion: Wrap MutationObserver instantiation in if (typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined') guard

finding: toast() factory function directly accesses document.querySelector, document.createElement, document.body without SSR guards. Calling server-side will throw.
suggestion: Add if (typeof document === 'undefined') throw new Error('toast() requires a browser environment'); at function entry

finding: hx-phi-field (Protected Health Information) is missing from fouc.css. Before element upgrades, PHI content in the default slot could flash as visible plain text — this is a privacy/compliance concern in healthcare.
suggestion: Add hx-phi-field:not(:defined) to fouc.css. Consider display: none instead of visibility: hidden for this component specifically.

finding: sideEffects is set to ['**/*.css'] which tells bundlers JS files have no side effects. However, every component JS file registers a custom element via @customElement() decorator as a side effect. A tree-shaking bundler could strip registrations, breaking CDN usage.
suggestion: Change sideEffects to true, or list all component entry points explicitly: ['**/*.css', './dist/components/*/index.js', './dist/index.js']

finding: Lit core (lit, @lit/*) and @helixui/tokens are externalized in Rollup config. When loaded via CDN <script type='module'>, bare module specifiers like 'import from lit' fail without an import map. The CDN URL in Drupal libraries.yml will produce runtime errors.
suggestion: Create a separate CDN bundle build that inlines Lit and token dependencies, or provide an importmap configuration for CDN consumers.

finding: CDN URL references dist/helix-library.js but Vite config produces dist/index.js as the main entry. The CDN path in libraries.yml will 404.
suggestion: Update libraries.yml CDN path to reference dist/index.js, or rename the Vite entry point key from 'index' to 'helix-library'.

finding: hx-banner is registered via @customElement but missing from fouc.css. Users will see FOUC for this component.
suggestion: Add hx-banner:not(:defined) to the fouc.css selector list.

finding: hx-clinical-status is registered via @customElement but missing from fouc.css. Healthcare-critical component — visible flash is unacceptable.
suggestion: Add hx-clinical-status:not(:defined) to fouc.css.

finding: hx-table and sub-components (hx-thead, hx-tbody, hx-tfoot, hx-tr, hx-th, hx-td) are all missing from fouc.css.
suggestion: Add all table sub-component tags to fouc.css.

finding: hx-tab and hx-tab-panel are registered via @customElement but missing from fouc.css. Tab content will flash before upgrade.
suggestion: Add hx-tab:not(:defined), hx-tab-panel:not(:defined) to fouc.css.

finding: hx-accordion-item is registered via @customElement but missing from fouc.css.
suggestion: Add hx-accordion-item:not(:defined) to fouc.css.

finding: Library only builds ES module format (formats: ['es']). No IIFE/UMD bundle for legacy CDN consumption via plain <script> tags (non-module).
suggestion: Consider adding an IIFE build for broad CDN compatibility, or document that type='module' is required on the script tag.

finding: helix-local library entry references dist/helix-library.js without type: module attribute. ES module files require type='module' on the script tag.
suggestion: Add attributes: { type: module } to the helix-local JS entry, matching the CDN entry pattern.

finding: Twig template uses 'hx-size' as the attribute name for the size property. The library component's @property decorator likely uses 'size' as the attribute name. The 'hx-size' attribute would be ignored.
suggestion: Verify that hx-button has @property({ attribute: 'hx-size' }) mapping. If not, change Twig template to use size='{{ size }}' instead.

finding: No components implement Declarative Shadow DOM (DSD) via <template shadowrootmode='open'>. SSR frameworks cannot pre-render shadow DOM content, causing blank flash until JS hydrates.
suggestion: Investigate Lit 3.x SSR support (@lit-labs/ssr) for server-rendering Declarative Shadow DOM.

finding: columns and rows properties use @property({ type: Array }) without a custom converter. Inconsistent with hx-nav's items which has explicit JSON converter with error handling.
suggestion: Add explicit converter: { fromAttribute(value) { try { return JSON.parse(value); } catch { return []; } } } to match hx-nav's pattern.

finding: items property accepts complex nested NavItem[] with children arrays. Frameworks using attribute-based binding must serialize deeply nested objects as JSON strings.
suggestion: Document that this property should be set via JavaScript property binding (.items in Vue, [items] in Angular) rather than HTML attribute for complex nested data.

finding: sideEffects: false declared but importing any React wrapper triggers custom element registration via @customElement() decorator — this IS a side effect. Bundlers could tree-shake needed registrations.
suggestion: Set sideEffects to true or list component files explicitly.

finding: navigator.clipboard.writeText() used without optional chaining. While only called from click handler (SSR-safe), navigator.clipboard may be undefined in non-secure (HTTP) contexts.
suggestion: Add navigator?.clipboard?.writeText() optional chaining for robustness.

finding: navigator.clipboard.writeText() used without optional chaining. Same issue as hx-copy-button.
suggestion: Add navigator?.clipboard?.writeText() optional chaining.

finding: navigator.clipboard.writeText() in _clearClipboard() without guard. User-triggered, so SSR-safe, but may fail in non-secure contexts.
suggestion: Add if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard) guard.

finding: No display property in :host. Component relies on browser default inline display, which may cause layout shift when shadow DOM renders.
suggestion: Add display: block to :host in hx-form.styles.ts.

finding: No display property in :host. Same layout shift risk as hx-form.
suggestion: Add display: block to :host in hx-prose.styles.ts.

finding: 28 sub-component tags missing from fouc.css: hx-toast-stack, hx-tree-item, hx-step, hx-stat, hx-counter, hx-radio, hx-nav-item, hx-menu-item, hx-menu-divider, hx-list-item, hx-grid-item, hx-carousel-item, hx-breadcrumb-item, hx-structured-list-row, hx-style-scope, and others.
suggestion: Add all 28 missing tags to fouc.css for complete FOUC prevention.

finding: Twig templates exist for only 11 of 80+ components. Missing templates for healthcare-critical components: hx-clinical-status, hx-phi-field, hx-form, hx-data-table.
suggestion: Prioritize Twig templates for healthcare-critical components in next Drupal integration sprint.
